method: Relevant sections of independently authored formation sources read; publisher errata page 5 visually inspected. Original discussion, summaries and questions; no copied publisher examples. These earlier-level grammar forms are retrieved in advanced listening, not advertised as exclusively N1.

points.form: Noun/person + にしたところで / にしたって
points.formation: A selected person/group noun followed by にしたところで introduces even that person’s limitation. Other plain-form attachments are acknowledged but not required here.
points.teachingChoice: Even the director cannot decide without costs. Negative results are common, not a universal requirement; avoid claiming permanent ignorance.

points.form: Noun + を踏まえて / を踏まえた + noun
points.formation: Ichidan 踏まえる; noun + を踏まえて informs an action, を踏まえた modifies a following noun.
points.teachingChoice: Survey response breakdown informs a proposal; neither representative population support nor approval is entailed.

points.form: Noun + に即して / に即した + noun
points.formation: に即して modifies an action; に即した modifies 案. Actual staffing circumstances here.
points.teachingChoice: Bunpro’s prose about before-noun use conflicts with its accurate formation table; no such exclusive-use claim is adopted. No absolute spelling prohibition about 則して.

points.form: Negative form + とも限らない
points.formation: Verb negative + とも限らない; 増えないとも限らない does not rule out an increase. iくない / na・nounではない or colloquialじゃない + とも限らない.
points.teachingChoice: Publisher errata corrected attachment table on printed page217 (PDFpage5) inspected visually. No fixed numerical probability or automatic positive certainty. Publisher level labels vary.

sourceCautions: Mainichi correct slug n1-nishitatte inspected; failed guessed n1-nishitatokorode not represented as read.
RapidJT article inspected but its broad low-probability/generality claims are not adopted.
Satō remains the teacher assisting a library survey; no unannounced librarian career.
Response counts are not population proportions or post-trial attendance. Four weeks is proposed, not approved.
A short original Violetto programme is supported practice, not proof of understanding real discussion programmes.
audioScope: Three original thirteen-line scenes at1.2; existing distinct Violetto cast deliveries, Clear vocabulary and task audio. No new model/recording/mascot art.
